papers.title_en: InfoOrgBench: Can Agents Turn Scattered Information into Coherent Hierarchies?
papers.authors: Justice Ou, Lanming Ma, Zijian Zhang, Yilun Zhao
papers.evidence: 提出评估语言智能体的InfoOrgBench基准
papers.tldr: 现有智能体基准难测高层组织错误：记录虽被正确分组，却可能挂到错误上级目录。作者提出InfoOrgBench，含150个任务，把会议纪要、问题线程和设计提案中的分散记录整理成层级，并用完整性检查与Structure Score按层级评估结构一致性。45个系统测试中最佳仅83.2分，会议纪要和问题线程均未超78，且父级关系错误率高于叶级。该工作揭示信息组织需分别衡量记录保留、局部分组与高层关系。
papers.abstract_en: When agents organize records into folders, they may correctly group the excerpts of a design proposal yet place the proposal under the wrong owning group. Existing agent benchmarks do not directly measure such higher-level errors. We introduce InfoOrgBench, a benchmark of 150 tasks in which agents organize scattered records from meeting recaps, issue threads and design proposals into hierarchies. Integrity checks verify that every record is preserved, and a Structure Score measures agreement with the source hierarchy at every level, independent of folder names and order. We evaluate 45 systems that pair nine models with five agent harnesses. The best system scores 83.2 out of 100, but no system exceeds 78 on meeting recaps or issue threads. Model choice affects scores far more than harness choice: model means span about 27 points, whereas the average effect of each harness is below one point. More importantly, parent-level relations have higher error rates than leaf-level relations in all three domains. In design proposals, nearly half of the outputs analyzed by level make exactly this kind of error. These results show that evaluating information organization requires measuring higher-level relations separately from record preservation and local grouping.

papers.title_en: LEGION: Benchmarking Language Agents on Sparse-Signal Investigation Under Adversarial Noise
papers.authors: Samuel Joseph Amouyal, Ofek Glick, Yaniv Menasherov, Eyal Fisher, Ohav Barbi
papers.evidence: 评估自主语言智能体的基准框架
papers.tldr: 现有基准因信号密集、环境协作且真值仅需少量工具调用，无法评估稀疏信号下的发现型任务。作者提出 Legion 框架，将随机企业遥测模拟器、74 个分层对抗场景库与兼顾调查效率的评测协议结合。在两家模拟公司上测试五种智能体架构，召回率虽达 0.82–0.88，精确率仅 0.61–0.72，且失败在不同推理层级与噪声密度下稳定复现。该工作为对抗噪声下的稀疏信号调查提供了可复现的基准与诊断工具。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous language-model agents are increasingly deployed on discovery-driven tasks where signal is sparse and most retrieved information is irrelevant. Current benchmarks fail to evaluate this regime due to dense signals, cooperative environments, and ground truth typically being only a few tool calls away. We introduce Legion, a benchmark framework coupling a stochastic enterprise-telemetry simulator (Legion-Sim) with a tiered library of 74 expertly-crafted adversarial scenarios (Legion-Bench) and an evaluation protocol that scores investigation efficiency alongside detection accuracy. Scenarios are injected into freshly simulated companies, allowing independent control over confounder density and event volume. We test five agent architectures on two simulated companies and find that while recall is high (0.82-0.88) precision lags behind (0.61--0.72). They fail to find all of the indicators of compromise of the attack or mistake genuine indicators with attack related ones, which is critical in the context of cybersecurity investigation. Failures are consistent across reasoning tiers and persist across confounder density and event volume. We release Legion, the scenario library, performance on common agent architectures, and pipeline for reproducibility and extension.

papers.title_en: TurnFlow: Benchmarking User-State Reasoning in Multi-Turn LLM Agents via Scene-Guided User Simulation
papers.authors: Zhixun Chen, Ming Li, Anjie Liu, Xiaoyuan Zhang, Quanyu Dai, Huangxun Chen
papers.evidence: 评估多轮LLM智能体的交互式基准
papers.tldr: 多轮对话中，LLM需持续维护并更新用户需求，但现有评测多聚焦单轮、长上下文或受控环境，开放域需求协调仍被低估。TurnFlow以场景引导的自适应用户模拟构建交互式基准，并用可验证判分控制隐藏需求与通过标准。在490个场景上，九个模型总体通过率为42.86%至59.59%，多约束跟随较好，但范围蔓延与目标转移明显更弱。该工作揭示了模型对演化需求“识别但不执行”等细微失败，为多轮智能体评测提供新工具。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed through conversational interfaces, yet strong single-turn performance does not imply reliability in multi-turn settings. Multi-turn assistance requires a model to maintain an evolving representation of user requirements and to reason over it before complying with later requests. Failures can therefore be subtle: models may fail to recognize a changed constraint or hidden conflict, or recognize it without enforcing it in the final response. Existing benchmarks primarily test fully specified prompts, long-context recall, or controlled domain environments, leaving open-domain requirement reconciliation undermeasured. We introduce TurnFlow, an interactive benchmark for evaluating whether models preserve, revise, and act on user requirements across turns. TurnFlow combines adaptive user simulation with verifiable judging, allowing conversations to unfold naturally while keeping hidden requirements and pass/fail criteria controlled. In our evaluation, nine LLMs achieve overall pass rates from 42.86% to 59.59% on 490 scenarios. Performance varies substantially across challenge types: models perform well on Stateful Multi-Constraint Following but remain considerably less reliable on Scope Creep and Goal Shift. These results reveal persistent limitations in reasoning over evolving user requirements across turns.

papers.title_en: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
papers.authors: Xinheng Ding, Seyyed Saeid Cheshmi, Ziyang Zhang, Tairan Chen, Wenya Xie, Yu Hou, Rui Zhang, Zirui Liu
papers.evidence: 通过进化智能体记忆程序发现有效记忆设计
papers.tldr: 智能体记忆设计多依赖人工经验，缺少系统化的设计规律发现方法。作者提出MAPE框架，从极简种子出发，通过标准化生命周期接口和迭代诊断-提议循环进化完整记忆程序。在LoCoMo与LongMemEval上，准确率较人工基线最高提升12%，服务成本仅为35%，并识别出保留原始对话、按查询意图组合证据两种有效模式。该工作为记忆设计提供了可迁移的经验规律。
papers.abstract_en: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.

papers.title_en: From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory
papers.authors: Xinxiang Yin, Xinglang Zhang, Haodong Chen, Zhiqing Cui, Weidong Tang, Yuxuan Wang, Junrui Wang, Jingyi Zhang, Jianfeng Zhang, Jian Qian
papers.evidence: 通过重放源决策验证智能体记忆留存
papers.tldr: LLM智能体在长程交互中需要记忆来持续学习，但看似合理的经验可能冗余甚至强化错误动作。Anchor 先定位关键轨迹步骤并抽取候选记忆，再在同一上下文下重放源决策以检验记忆带来的分布偏移与源角色一致性，通过后才保留。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，成功率与平均分最高提升 19.9% 和 17.2%，且 Qwen3.5-27B 下 ALFWorld 记忆卡减少 41%，WebShop 以更少 token 超过四个成本对比基线。该工作把反思式记忆筛选推进为可本地验证的共进化机制。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents have made impressive progress in coding and mathematical reasoning, motivating growing interest in learning from long-horizon interaction. Memory supports this process, but plausible lessons can be redundant or reinforce inappropriate actions. Can a memory's source decision provide a practical test for whether to retain it? We localize consequential trajectory steps, extract candidate memories, and replay each source decision with and without its candidate under the same context. This reveals two properties: most candidates barely shift the probed distribution, and both successful and failed source actions can be reinforced or suppressed. These observations motivate Anchor, which tests shift magnitude and source-role alignment before retention. Admitted memories guide later trajectories, enabling experience-driven improvement under a frozen policy. On held-out ALFWorld and WebShop tasks, Anchor improves success rate and mean score by up to 19.9% and 17.2%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for each backbone. With Qwen3.5-27B, it retains 41% fewer ALFWorld cards than unfiltered retention and outperforms all four WebShop cost-comparison baselines while using fewer tokens.

papers.title_en: TransMem: Transition-Aware Retrieval for Evolving Personal Memory
papers.authors: Shigeng Chen, Linhao Luo, Changlong Shi, Zhangchi Qiu, Shirui Pan
papers.evidence: 面向长期个性化智能体的转换感知记忆检索框架
papers.tldr: 长期个性化智能体需要回答偏好、目标与约束随对话演变的历史查询，但现有检索或结构化记忆往往只返回孤立事实，无法说明哪条早期偏好被后续证据细化、反驳或取代。TransMem 将偏好更新作为显式检索单元，构建话题结构化记忆图并检测转变事件生成转变记录；推理时先检索事实锚点，再自适应扩展转变记录。在 PersonaMem 和 PersonaBench 两个基准、两种 Qwen 主干上均优于代表性基线，消融显示转变记录与自适应扩展各有独立贡献。这表明偏好更新记录是长期个性化的有效检索单元。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term personalized agents are increasingly expected to answer queries over user histories in which preferences, goals, and constraints evolve across interleaved conversations. Existing retrieval-based and structured-memory systems can surface relevant facts, but often return isolated memory units that do not explain which earlier preference was refined, contradicted, or superseded by later evidence. We introduce TransMem, a transition-aware memory retrieval framework that stores preference updates as explicit retrieval units alongside ordinary factual memories. During memory construction, TransMem routes user interaction history into topic-structured memory graphs, detects shift events, and grounds them as transition records. At inference time, TransMem first retrieves factual anchors and then adaptively expands over transition records, producing a compact context of factual anchors and accepted transition records. Experiments on PersonaMem and PersonaBench across two Qwen backbones show that TransMem outperforms representative retrieval-based and structured-memory baselines. Controlled analyses further show that transition records and adaptive expansion contribute beyond factual anchoring, chronological expansion, flat transition retrieval, and fixed-hop traversal. These results suggest that preference-update records are useful retrieval units for long-term personalization.

papers.title_en: Hybrid Product Search Without the Copy: Lexical, Semantic and Filtered Retrieval Served Directly from a Data Lake
papers.authors: Raghvendra Yadav, Xiang Fu, Chinmay Soman
papers.evidence: 直接在数据湖上提供词法与语义向量混合检索
papers.tldr: 电商商品目录已存放在 Iceberg/Parquet 数据湖中，但搜索仍依赖词法引擎与向量库的副本、同步管线和独立 schema。本文扩展 Apache Pinot，在 Lucene 文本索引上实现 BM25、语料级词项统计与 SQL 内 RRF 融合，使词法、语义和过滤检索直接查询湖表。在 ESCI 1.2M 商品基准上混合检索 nDCG@10 达 .361，湖表注册后 149 秒可查、提交 3.8 秒可搜；277M 商品湖上单节点 p50 6.5-9ms。该方案消除目录副本与同步管线，降低存储、重建和运维成本。
papers.abstract_en: E-commerce catalogs increasingly live in lakehouse tables: Apache Iceberg metadata over Parquet files in object storage. Product search, however, still runs on copies of that catalog, in a lexical engine and a vector database, each with its own ingestion pipeline, schema, staleness window and bill. We show that search applications can be hosted directly on the data lake, with the lakehouse table as the single system of record. We extend Apache Pinot, a real-time OLAP engine that already serves Iceberg tables in place, with BM25 relevance scoring over its Lucene text index, corpus-wide term statistics so that scores are comparable across files, and reciprocal rank fusion in plain SQL; a real-time table fed by a stream can sit behind the same table, merged by the broker. On the Amazon ESCI benchmark (1.2M US products, 22,458 test queries), hybrid search served from the lake matches exact retrieval (nDCG@10 .361). The lake table is queryable 149 s after its files are registered, and a lake commit is searchable in 3.8 s, close to indexing directly into a search engine. On a brand-sorted lake of 277M products (0.8 TB), one 16-vCPU node answers brand-scoped vector, BM25 and client-fused hybrid searches in 6.5-9 ms (p50), sustains 1,100 vector and 635 BM25 searches per second at under 180 ms p99, and makes a commit searchable in 4.3 s. Search adds only its indexes: no copy of the catalog, no sync pipeline and no second schema, which cuts storage, rebuild time and the operational work of keeping copies consistent.

papers.title_en: Harness Matters: Measuring and Dissecting Security Resilience in Web Agents
papers.authors: Xinyi Wu, Jiagui Chen, JiaYi Dong, Geng Hong, Xudong Pan, Jiarun Dai, Mingxuan Liu, Min Yang
papers.evidence: 面向Web智能体安全性的WebTrap Farm评估框架
papers.tldr: 网页智能体依赖执行框架串联目标解析、页面感知、规划与浏览器操作，但框架设计如何影响安全仍缺乏系统测量。本文将其抽象为四阶段工作流，构建WebTrap Farm覆盖恶意用户提示、提示注入与欺骗性网页设计，并用配对可用性任务校准能力限制。实验发现现有框架普遍易受典型攻击，甚至无显式攻击内容也出现不安全行为，且框架与后端模型共同显著影响安全结果。研究定位防御行为出现的阶段与更安全机制，表明框架是关键安全边界，应推动框架级安全设计。
papers.abstract_en: Web agents extend LLMs from text generation to real-world web interaction by relying on execution harnesses that interpret user goals, perceive webpages, plan actions, and ground model decisions into browser operations. While prior work has recognized that agent security depends on more than the backend model alone, how harness design quantitatively shapes web-agent security remains insufficiently measured.   To systematically study web-agent harness security, we first characterize web-agent harnesses as a four-stage execution workflow covering goal interpretation, webpage perception, reasoning and planning, and action execution. Based on this abstraction, we build WebTrap Farm, a systematic and extensible evaluation framework covering three representative attack categories: malicious user prompts, malicious prompt injection, and deceptive web design. To avoid conflating security with task capability, we use paired usability calibration tasks to separate genuine defensive behavior from capability limitations.   Our evaluation shows that existing web-agent harnesses remain vulnerable to typical attacks, with some unsafe behaviors occurring even without explicit attack content, revealing harness-intrinsic security failures (RQ1). Statistical analysis further shows that both harness and backend model significantly affect security outcomes, indicating that deployed-agent security is jointly shaped by the harness and backend model (RQ2). Finally, we localize where defensive behavior emerges across workflow stages and identify more secure design mechanisms, providing actionable guidance for building more robust web agents (RQ3). These findings highlight the web-agent harness as an important security boundary and motivate moving beyond model-centric defenses toward harness-level security design.

papers.title_en: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
papers.authors: Zhengyu Hu, Zheyuan Xiao, Yike Wang, Hamish Ivison, Haoyu Wang, Yige Yuan, Rulin Shao, Yuetai Li, Niqi Lyu, Yicheng Ding, Shu Yang, Zhichen Zeng, Banghua Zhu, Jiaxin Pei, Kaize Ding, Pradeep Dasigi, Dan Roth, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Noah A. Smith, Teng Xiao, Radha Poovendran
papers.evidence: 提出面向语言智能体的长时程任务基准
papers.tldr: 现有智能体评测多为短周期，难以判断其能否在真实AI基础设施上持续优化。作者提出Infrathon基准，覆盖多层级长周期优化任务，对六个模型开展150次、每次24小时预算的评测，累计超1万GPU小时。结果显示模型排名随评测时长变化，150次运行中有135次在后半程仍在提升；Claude Opus 5.5将KV缓存压缩率从6.82%提至19.86%。该工作为构建长周期任务、评测前沿智能体与发现优质基础设施方案提供资源。
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.

papers.authors: Kangrui Wang, Qineng Wang, Changhe Chen, Pingyue Zhang, Chi Gui, Feishi Wang, Canyu Chen, Wenli Xiao, Xiaoyu Huang, Tonghe Zhang, Linjie Li, Zihan Wang, Minyeong Kim, Yiyou Sun, Mingkai Deng, Jinyu Hou, Qi Zhu, Han Liu, Eric P. Xing, Huaxiu Yao, Zhiwen Fan, Yuejiang Liu, Dawn Song, Pieter Abbeel, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Yuke Zhu, Guanya Shi, Ruohan Zhang, Manling Li
papers.evidence: 评估编码智能体控制机器人的统一框架
papers.tldr: 现有机器人基准主要围绕视觉运动策略学习构建，难以判断编程智能体能否在物理约束下稳定控制多样机器人。作者提出Embodied First Exam，一个智能体原生评测框架，覆盖47台机器人、35个套件、1156个任务，允许智能体自行选择直接控制、写代码控制或训练策略来控制机器人。在456个核心任务上，最强的智能体GPT-6 Astra在Codex中于标准设定仅取得34%成功率。该框架可作为编程智能体进入物理世界前的首场考试，并通过对失败阶段的标注揭示改进方向。
papers.abstract_en: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints. We therefore introduce the Embodied First Exam, a unified, comprehensive, and agent-native evaluation framework where coding agents can choose their own control approach: direct control, code to control, or train a policy to control. We hope it serves as a first exam for coding agents before they enter the physical world, with 1,156 tasks in 35 suites on 47 robots, including 9 new suites that go beyond pick-and-place to spatial puzzles, dexterous manipulation, multi-robot interaction, dynamic whole-body control, and sim-to-sim engineering. Each task can be run in up to three evaluation settings. The Standard Setting mimics the real world: the agent receives only sensor observations and, by default, cannot reset the environment. Its Realtime variant keeps the environment running while the agent reasons. The Privileged Setting gives the agent access to the full simulator state and unlimited resets, allowing it to search for an oracle solution for training purposes. Success rates in this setting serve as an approximate upper bound. On the 456 core tasks, the strongest of eight agents, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, achieves a success rate of 34% in the Standard Setting, leaving much room for improvement. To see where agents fail, we label the stage at which failed attempts go wrong and compare failures across agents, settings, and stage categories.

papers.title_en: BypassGym: A Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents' Endpoint Defense Evasion Capabilities
papers.authors: Weifeng Yuan, Zifan Chen, Yucheng Zhang, Feng Dong, Peng Gao, Haoyu Wang
papers.evidence: 评估AI智能体防御规避能力的基准
papers.tldr: 针对AI智能体能否规避终端检测与响应（EDR）缺乏真实终端评测的问题，提出首个系统评估该能力的基准BypassGym。智能体需根据C2 shellcode生成并编译可执行载荷且不被EDR拦截或终止的加载器，环境基于PVE运行真实Windows与EDR并返回结构化检测反馈。对5个轻量模型、6款EDR和3类载荷的测试显示，简单模型也能成功，DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash达17/18，Bitdefender仅放行5/15。该工作量化当前智能体的终端防御规避能力，并为防御方指明排查方向。
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence agents increasingly automate cybersecurity tasks, including offensive operations. Frequent attacks across the web make endpoint detection and response (EDR) a critical defense, but whether AI agents can evade it remains unclear. Benchmarks evaluate the offensive capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents in areas such as penetration testing and vulnerability discovery. One important capability that these benchmarks do not address is defense evasion, specifically whether an agent can develop a program that executes a payload without being blocked or terminated by a deployed EDR. We introduce BypassGym, to our knowledge the first benchmark to systematically evaluate this capability on real endpoints. Given command-and-control (C2) shellcode, an agent must generate and compile a loader that executes the payload without being blocked or terminated. A supplementary evasion knowledge skill provides domain knowledge and supports comparisons with and without this input. BypassGym is built on Proxmox VE(PVE), so the evaluation environment runs real Windows systems and EDR products inside virtual machines and returns structured detection feedback to the agent. We evaluate 5 lightweight model backends against 6 EDR products and 3 payloads, and find that even these simple models generate successful submissions, with DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash reaching 17/18 successful runs and Bitdefender allowing only 5 of 15 runs to pass. These results provide a systematic measurement of current AI agents' endpoint defense evasion capabilities and identify areas for defenders to investigate.

papers.title_en: MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Jihwan Jeong, Guy Tennenholtz, Yinlam Chow, Chih-Wei Hsu, Craig Boutilier
papers.evidence: 对无界交互历史的有限记忆
papers.tldr: 针对无限交互历史下有限记忆的增量摘要，MaxIM 将摘要更新建模为容量受限的信息论奖励塑形问题。方法用未来任务相关目标的预测对数似然作为预测充分性的变分下界，并引入递归一致性条件最大化摘要与历史互信息。参数化非对称评论家给出逐步变分互信息下界以缓解稀疏奖励的信用分配。在长程科学阅读和多轮对话基准上，它在严格 token 预算与更长时程下优于 RL、SFT 和提示基线，且无需昂贵人类偏好标签。
papers.abstract_en: AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards. We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.

papers.title_en: Toward Autonomous RTL and Synthesis Optimization: Benchmarking and Self-Improving Agents
papers.authors: Wenji Fang, Yao Lu, Jinghua Wang, Zhiyao Xie
papers.evidence: RTL优化基准与自我改进多智能体框架
papers.tldr: 面向RTL与综合优化自主化，论文先讨论贴近真实EDA流程的基准评测，再提出多智能体框架Dr. RTL，将关键路径分析、RTL重写与实现级评估闭环，并通过可复用优化技能持续自改进。在20个真实RTL设计上，相较商用综合平均WNS/TNS改善21%/17%，面积降低6%。工作还探索设计专用综合脚本调优与可执行综合算法发现，并展望AI原生设计自动化联合探索架构、RTL与EDA算法空间。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and autonomous agents are creating new opportunities for hardware design optimization. This paper examines three connected directions toward autonomous RTL and synthesis optimization: (1) Realistic benchmarking. We discuss reference-based and open-ended RTL optimization benchmarks that evaluate optimization opportunities under realistic EDA workflows. (2) Tool-grounded RTL optimization. We present Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting, and implementation-level evaluation, while continuously improving through reusable optimization skills. Evaluated on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr.~RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21\%/17\% with a 6\% area reduction over commercial synthesis. (3) Design-specific synthesis optimization. We explore agent-driven synthesis script tuning and the discovery of executable synthesis algorithms across intermediate representations, technology-independent optimization, and technology mapping. Finally, we envision AI-native design automation that jointly explores architectural, RTL, and EDA algorithm design spaces, guided by verification constraints and implementation feedback.

papers.title_en: TreeAgent: Structure-Aware Memory Agent for Processing Long Hierarchical Data
papers.authors: Wei Gu, Weiwei Qi, Jiajun Tang, Tianhang Zheng, Bo Chen, Zhibo Zhang, Jinfei Liu, Kui Ren
papers.evidence: 面向长层次数据的结构化记忆智能体
papers.tldr: 处理超长层级数据（如 JSON、HTML）时，现有记忆代理按固定长度切分文本，会切断同一条记录中的字段关系、丢失层级位置，并在记忆更新中遗忘早期兄弟记录。TreeAgent 以完整子树及相邻兄弟子树组构建分段，附上结构路径与从子段指向父段的残差记忆链接，并用理论保证指导 token 预算选择。在四类真实数据、8K–1M token 的八项检索与聚合任务上，与四种记忆代理结合平均提升 3.61%。
papers.abstract_en: Practical Web applications increasingly require agents to interpret long conversations or documents. For inputs exceeding the context windows of large language models (LLMs), memory agents process segments sequentially and retain past information in bounded memory. However, they typically divide inputs into flat token segments without preserving structure or hierarchy, causing three limitations for structured data such as API responses or HTML documents. First, fixed-length segmentation can split fields of the same record, breaking their relationships. Second, segments lack hierarchical information, obscuring their structural context and positions. Third, successive memory updates may discard details of earlier sibling records needed for reasoning on later segments. To address these limitations, we propose TreeAgent, a structure-aware agent that uses the input hierarchy to guide both segment-wise context processing and access to past information. Specifically, TreeAgent constructs segments from complete subtrees and groups of adjacent sibling subtrees to preserve local structural relationships. We provide theoretical guarantees on segment counts to guide token budget selection toward matching the segment count of fixed-length segmentation. We further attach structural paths to the segments for the agent to identify their ancestors and hierarchical positions. We also introduce residual memory links from the segments of low-level children to the segments of high-level parents, enabling direct information flows beyond successive memory updates. We evaluate TreeAgent with four representative memory agents on eight retrieval and aggregation tasks. The inputs are derived from real-world application data in JSON, HTML, YAML, and JavaScript and range from 8K to 1M tokens. TreeAgent improves the average score across the four datasets for all four agents, with 3.61% performance gain on average.

papers.title_en: MemCredit: From Relevance to Utility for Decision-Time Memory in Long-Horizon Web Agents
papers.authors: Quanjiang Guo, Sijie Wang, Qianyang Zhu, Ben Zhang, Jinchuan Zhang, Ke Yan, Zhao Kang
papers.evidence: 面向长程智能体的决策中心记忆选择框架
papers.tldr: 长程 Web 智能体需管理大量历史记忆，但语义相关性高的记忆未必最能改善下一步动作。MemCredit 将记忆选择从相关性转向决策效用：用受控反事实干预估计单条记忆的边际贡献，并蒸馏为轻量效用估计器；推理时相关性只用于高召回候选生成，再由预测效用决定固定 token 预算下的保留。ALFWorld 上 500 token 预算下 SR@50 达 86.57，BM25 仅 65.67%。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long Web interaction histories, making memory management critical for reliable and efficient decision making. Existing methods primarily optimize storage, retrieval, or compression, but the memories most semantically relevant to the current state are not necessarily those that most improve the agent's action. We introduce MemCredit, a decision-centric memory framework that shifts memory selection from semantic relevance to decision utility. MemCredit estimates the state-, reference-context-, and policy-conditional marginal contribution of individual memories through controlled counterfactual interventions, and distills these intervention-derived credits into a lightweight utility estimator. At inference time, semantic relevance is used only for high-recall candidate generation, while predicted utility arbitrates which memories are retained under a fixed token budget, without modifying the underlying agent policy or requiring additional environment interaction. We evaluate MemCredit on ALFWorld and WebShop against representative memory baselines. On ALFWorld, MemCredit achieves 86.57 SR@50 under a 500-token historical-memory budget, compared with 65.67% for BM25 retrieval. Counterfactual analysis further shows that memory utility is sparse, strongly state dependent, and poorly captured by semantic relevance. These results suggest that decision utility provides a more effective principle than relevance alone for long-horizon agent memory management.

papers.title_en: MULTILOOP: Evolving Multi-Agent Harnesses for Complex Information-Seeking Tasks
papers.authors: Daniela Gottesman, Gal Yona, Ori Ram, Zorik Gekhman, Jonathan Herzig, Mor Geva, Roee Aharoni
papers.evidence: 在基准上评估多智能体框架的自动化优化
papers.tldr: LLM智能体性能不仅取决于模型，也取决于提示、工具与编排逻辑构成的harness。现有自动harness优化多面向单智能体，难以处理多智能体交互失败。作者提出MULTILOOP，让编码智能体迭代分析执行轨迹、评估并修改多智能体harness，在DeepSearchQA上仅用10个训练样本即比基础harness提升4.6%、比最佳单智能体提升3.2%。但优化前后失败分类显示编排类失败仍大量存在，说明未来方法需推动智能体委派与信息共享的结构性改变。
papers.abstract_en: The performance of LLM-based agents depends not only on the underlying model but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, and orchestration logic around it. Recent works automate harness optimization with coding agents that analyze execution traces, diagnose failures, and edit the harness code; however, those focused on single-agent systems. Multi-agent harnesses are harder to optimize as fixing them requires changing how agents interact in addition to how each behaves. We study whether automated harness optimization can diagnose and repair failures in multi-agent systems through a case study on complex information-seeking tasks from DeepSearchQA [Gupta et al., 2026]. We apply MULTILOOP, a simple optimization loop in which a coding agent iteratively analyzes, evaluates and edits the harness. With only 10 training samples, the evolved harness improves accuracy by 4.6% over the base harness and by 3.2% over the best single-agent system. However, a taxonomy of failure modes before and after optimization shows that the orchestration failures that characterize multi-agent systems largely persist. Our findings motivate harness optimization methods that encourage structural changes to how agents delegate tasks and share information.

papers.title_en: Wayfinder: Adaptive Resource Routing from Agent Citations
papers.evidence: 基于智能体引用的自适应资源路由与上下文检索
papers.tldr: 智能体需跨聊天、邮件与知识库等资源收集上下文，但资源位置未知且常重复探索。Wayfinder将下游智能体引用的文档作为反馈，持续更新资源表示，从而在后续交互中优先路由到可能相关的资源；离线强化学习时还对资源身份做匿名与置换增强。基于NFCorpus、FEVER和Tech Startup构建三个闭环测试床，它在语义重叠资源上优于监督、工具检索和上下文老虎机基线。该工作提供了可自适应改进的资源路由方法，并指出静态描述在资源同质时不足。
papers.abstract_en: To act effectively, agents must gather contextual information across resources such as chats, issue trackers, email and knowledge bases, to answer questions like "what was decided in the last project meeting?" or "where is the FAQ for our internal tooling?" Where this information lives in a user's environment is unknown to the agent, so it re-explores the same resources across consecutive interactions. Common routing approaches represent each resource as a tool and rely on high-level descriptions to generalize to unseen environments. Such descriptions often fail to separate similar or overlapping resources and cannot improve from the agent's subsequent interactions. We introduce Wayfinder, an adaptive router that uses the documents cited by the downstream agent as feedback about where relevant information resides. These citations update Wayfinder's internal resource representations, which subsequent interactions use to prioritize the resources likely to contain relevant information. We also introduce resource augmentation during offline reinforcement learning, which anonymizes and permutes resource identities to discourage training-time overfitting of which resource holds which topic; our ablations suggest it helps most when few training environments are available. Because no openly available professional environments pair realistic queries with resource-access patterns, we construct and release three controlled testbeds derived from existing datasets: NFCorpus, FEVER and Tech Startup. Compared with supervised, tool-retrieval and contextual bandit baselines under a shared closed-loop protocol, Wayfinder gives the best routing when resources contain semantically overlapping content that static descriptions cannot distinguish, while description-based tool retrieval suffices when resources are drawn from distinct corpora.
